we provide a set of robust tag SNPs which is able to capture the haplotypes with missing data, and our algorithms are efficient in terms of both computation time and approximation factor.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the number of robust tag SNPs is much smaller than the number of tag SNPs.
the robust tag SNPs can be selected by a greedy algorithm with approximation ratio of \(m\ln K\).
the problem of selecting robust tag SNPs is NP-hard, and the greedy algorithm is the first approximation algorithm with provable performance guarantee for this problem.
